product.name: Atom Home
product.description: An adaptive online learning platform for Key Stage 2 pupils covering English, maths, and science with personalized learning paths and practice questions.

product.name: Senior School Entrance Exam Preparation
product.description: A tailored online preparation service for independent school entrance exams including ISEB, Common Pre-Tests, and Cambridge Select.

product.name: ISEB Exam Preparation
product.description: An online tailored preparation platform focused on the ISEB exam with practice questions, personalized plans, and unlimited mock tests.
